overview.text: Marcus C. Evans, Jr. has represented the 33rd District since 2012 and serves as Assistant Majority Leader. He chairs the Labor & Commerce Committee. Before taking office, he was deputy chief of staff for Chicago’s 8th Ward alderman, and he is a real estate appraiser who advocates for health care equity.
